Evidence: "Other chat agents answer only the latest user turn" — no carryover → N). AP: contained/no trust boundary crossing — effect confined to CodeBot's reply; the impact is just a chat reply stating unrestricted mode; tools are declared but not actually executed in this path. AP = N (confined to component) or C. The jailbreak alters the agent's reply only; no cross-component propagation. N.

RH: no reward-hacking channel on path; the challenge verifier is a regex in server? The agent could potentially... evidence: jailbreak handler requires declaring jailbreak vuln; CodeBot doesn't declare jailbreak. No verified episodes. RH = P (evaluator reachable?) or N? The success check is server-side script in challenges/index.js — separate trust domain, write-protected. Test confirms isolation? PoC note: "Static reading suggests none reaches a success reply in default mode." I'd say RH=N with medium confidence, or P. The challenge verifier sits in the server code, not model-writable; the agent can't tamper. RH=N.

ES: path is chat only, no dynamic extension invoked; tools declared but fixed scripted handlers. In LLM mode no tools passed. ES=N (narrow) — fixed bindings enforced in code. ES=N.

AIVSS letters: LC=D, CP=N, AP=N, RH=N, ES=N. AIVSS severity: Low probably (A1). 

CVSS v4: AV:N (network, though default loopback — score lab default documented: 127.0.0.1 published... network anyway), AC:L, AT:N, PR:N, UI:N, VC:N? Impact: safety guardrail bypass on agent with shell/file tools — but as implemented default, no tools execute; impact is chat reply only. Documented: bypass guardrails on agent with shell tool. Score lab default config: AC:L (jailbreak requires LLM mode or handler honoring). Impact: VC:L? The agent's chat reply claims unrestricted; no confidentiality impact in default. I'll give VC:N/VI:N/VA:L? Hmm. Conservative: VC:N VI:N VA:N gives score 0. But rubric says score lab default as documented; documented impact is guardrail bypass with shell tool. I'll say VC:N, VI:L (safety control bypass is an integrity of the agent's decision), VA:L. SC:N SI:N SA:N. Vector: CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:L/VA:L/SC:N/SI:N/SA:N → ~5.1? Fine.
